note: The module has two config surfaces, both used by the cases below. Per text format: editor.editor.<format> -> settings.toolbar.items must contain the toolbar item 'bootstrapGrid' and settings.plugins.ckeditor_bs_grid_grid holds use_cdn / cdn_url / available_columns / available_breakpoints (CKEditor5 plugin id ckeditor_bs_grid_grid, class Drupal\ckeditor_bs_grid\Plugin\CKEditor5Plugin\BsGrid). Site-wide: ckeditor_bs_grid.settings -> breakpoints.<xs|sm|md|lg|xl|xxl> with label, prefix and columns.<1..12>.layouts, edited at /admin/config/content/ckeditor_bs_grid behind the administer ckeditor_bs_grid permission. Medium cases install real config on both surfaces; hard cases build a new CKEditor 5 format and extend an existing one, verified against the live editor entities. Cleanup restores ckeditor_bs_grid.settings from the module's own config/install file.

evals.prompt: I installed the Drupal module ckeditor_bs_grid on a Drupal 11 site but I see no way to insert a grid. How do I make the Bootstrap Grid button available to editors, and what is the toolbar item called?
evals.expected_output: Go to /admin/config/content/formats, edit a text format that uses CKEditor 5, and drag the 'Bootstrap Grid' button (toolbar item id bootstrapGrid, plugin id ckeditor_bs_grid_grid) from Available buttons into the Active toolbar, then make sure the format does not strip <div class data-*>. Saving stores it in editor.editor.<format> settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: Which per-text-format settings does the Drupal ckeditor_bs_grid module store, and in which configuration object do they live?
evals.expected_output: In editor.editor.<format> under settings.plugins.ckeditor_bs_grid_grid: use_cdn (bool, default TRUE), cdn_url (default the jsDelivr bootstrap 5.2.3 CSS, loaded only inside CKEditor), available_columns (default 1-12) and available_breakpoints (default xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl).

evals.prompt: Where do the column layout choices (like 'Equal Width' or '25% / 75%') that the ckeditor_bs_grid dialog offers come from in Drupal, and which config object holds them?
evals.expected_output: From the site-wide config object ckeditor_bs_grid.settings, key 'breakpoints': one entry per Bootstrap breakpoint (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl) with a label, a prefix (none for xs) and a columns tree keyed 1-12, each holding named layouts whose settings map col-<n> to a width token (a number, 'equal' or 'auto'). It is edited at /admin/config/content/ckeditor_bs_grid with the 'administer ckeditor_bs_grid' permission.

evals.prompt: One text format on this Drupal site has the CKEditor Bootstrap Grid button enabled. Inspect the live configuration and report which column counts and which breakpoints editors may choose in that format, and whether Bootstrap CSS is loaded from a CDN inside the editor (give the URL that is configured).
evals.expected_output: Format ckbsgrid_eval: editor.editor.ckbsgrid_eval settings.plugins.ckeditor_bs_grid_grid has available_columns 1, 2 and 3, available_breakpoints xs and md, use_cdn FALSE and cdn_url https://cdn.example.com/bootstrap-grid.min.css (so the CDN stylesheet is configured but switched off).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the CKEditor Bootstrap Grid layout catalogue has been customised. Inspect the live configuration and report the label the 'md' breakpoint now uses and the full list of two-column layouts it offers.
evals.expected_output: ckeditor_bs_grid.settings breakpoints.md.label is 'Tablet (md)' and breakpoints.md.columns.2.layouts contains Equal Width, Auto, 25% / 75%, 33% / 66%, 66% / 33%, 75% / 25%, Full Width and the added 20% / 80% (col-1: 2, col-2: 10).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a new text format with the machine name ckbsgrid_task that uses CKEditor 5 and has the CKEditor Bootstrap Grid button in its toolbar. Restrict the grid plugin in that format so editors may only pick 1, 2, 3 or 4 columns and only the xs and lg breakpoints. Apply everything to the live site.
evals.expected_output: filter.format.ckbsgrid_task plus editor.editor.ckbsgrid_task with editor: ckeditor5, settings.toolbar.items containing bootstrapGrid, and settings.plugins.ckeditor_bs_grid_grid.available_columns = [1,2,3,4] and available_breakpoints = [xs, lg].

evals.prompt: The text format 'CKBSGrid Plain' (machine name ckbsgrid_plain) on this Drupal site uses CKEditor 5 but has no Bootstrap Grid button. Add the CKEditor Bootstrap Grid button to that format's toolbar, turn OFF the option that loads Bootstrap from a CDN inside the editor, and set the CDN URL field to https://example.com/bootstrap-grid.css . Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: editor.editor.ckbsgrid_plain settings.toolbar.items now contains bootstrapGrid and settings.plugins.ckeditor_bs_grid_grid has use_cdn: false and cdn_url: 'https://example.com/bootstrap-grid.css'.
